label: Flowchart
description: An animated flowchart laid out in layers from the edges (branches fan out, chains run straight), sized from the box so labels read at video scale. Built layer by layer: nodes rise, connectors draw, each arrowhead lands with its line. Roots are tinted, the final layer is filled in the brand primary; a node color makes a sticky-note chip.

color.description: Optional flat chip color (hex): sticky-note chip with auto dark/light text -- the whiteboard look on light backdrops.

edges.label: Edges {from, to}; omit for a chain in node order

edge_color.label: Edge Color
edge_color.description: Connector color (default: the brand primary). A dark neutral suits whiteboard-style colored chips.

flow.label: After the build, a dot runs along each connector (a process that keeps running)

theme.label: Ink theme; omit to follow the measured scene ground

at.label: Seconds into the scene the build starts (default 0.2)

exit.label: Fade out before the scene ends (default: hold; the cut is the exit)
